prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Attached image is the definitive CHARACTER and STYLE reference. Create artwork for the existing Futbol Island stories with this exact visibly LOW POLYGON aesthetic. Angular planar faces, square rectangular eyes with small flat dark pupils, angular noses, polygonal cheeks and limbs, chunky triangulated hair, matte flat-shaded surfaces with visible large polygon planes. No round glossy oversized eyes, no smooth Pixar-like faces, no soft plastic skin. Match the reference cast, charcoal numbered kits, warm island lighting and waterfront. IMPORTANT: exactly THREE equal-height wide landscape scenes stacked vertically in one 1024x1536 portrait image, each scene exactly 1024x512 (2:1). No gutters, no borders. All heads and bodies comfortably within each panel. Same camera and geography across the three moments. No text or labels except jersey numbers and the specified scoreboard. Cast: Luna, the central brown-haired high ponytail girl number10 in reference, and Kai, curly dark-haired boy in reference. Warm afternoon near island goal. TOP: Luna has just missed a chance, shoulders lowered, ball wide of goal; Kai nearby giving space. MIDDLE: Luna takes a breath and looks back toward play, upright ready to offer support, ball stays wide. BOTTOM: Kai stands beside Luna giving a gentle encouraging cue; Luna listens and looks toward play. Emotion subtle, supportive and credible. Luna must retain reference ponytail, brown eyes and charcoal kit.
